annotation.bound_parties_text: The annexes to the proposal refer to providers (and their authorised representatives), notified bodies and users of AI systems, but the excerpt contains no operative provision imposing obligations; the annexes support the main proposal.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The provider verifies that the established quality management system is in compliance with the requirements of Article 17.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ANNEXES to the Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council LAYING DOWN HARMONISED RULES ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE ACT)
